Do not lower or raise bed walls. Do not change the original irrigation tubes or room.

Bottom left identical three beds with small potato seedlings left, soybean seedlings centre, lettuce seedlings right, all uncovered. Bottom right precisely the same seedlings in the same places and sizes, plus exactly the same loose surface cover on the left bed, shoots protruding loosely through flaps. The foil cover adds darkness over the exposed medium and leaves shoots in light.
